name: howto
title: The Rubbermaid Brilliance in five minutes
sub: What the box and the test kitchen say, in order
footer: Sources: America's Test Kitchen (Dec 10, 2025); Target listing (Oct 13, 2026). Rubbermaid's own care page could not be read.

items.head: Wash before first use
items.body: Hand-wash; the gasket is attached, so clean it in place.

items.head: Cool the food
items.body: Seal at room temperature, not hot (ATK).

items.head: Latch both sides
items.body: Press until both latches click over the gasket.

items.head: Microwave: reheat only
items.body: Target's listing says open the vented latches first.

items.head: Dishwasher: top rack
items.body: Allowed on Target's listing; ATK advises hand-washing.
